yt-dlp (experimental Links — not in stable JW Converter releases yet)

Project: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp
License: Unlicense (public domain dedication) — see upstream COPYING
Windows builds: https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases

JW Converter experimental Links Phase 6 uses a local yt-dlp executable for:
- metadata inspection and flat playlist entry discovery (`--dump-single-json --flat-playlist`)
- queued single-item public downloads (two workers; argv-only)
- optional user-selected Netscape `cookies.txt`, subtitles, thumbnails, and duration-limited live recording
- optional updater downloads from the official yt-dlp GitHub release API

The app does not import browser cookies or alter browser security policy.

FFmpeg remains required for merge/remux/transcode and is covered by
THIRD_PARTY_FFMPEG.txt / FFMPEG-LICENSING.md.

Do not redistribute a stable installer that bundles yt-dlp until:
- the binary version and hash are pinned in this notice
- packaging/externalBin wiring is reviewed
- a licensing pass for the chosen build is complete

Current status: development sidecar only (`src-tauri/binaries/yt-dlp.exe`
or CONVERTER_YTDLP). Not included in public 0.5.x releases.
